CREATE TABLE workspaces (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE auth_tokens (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	agent_id VARCHAR, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	delegation JSONB NOT NULL, 
	parent_token_id VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE handshakes (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	agent_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	host_origin VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE audit (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	resource_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	detail JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_workspace_id ON audit (workspace_id)

CREATE TABLE documents (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_documents_workspace_id ON documents (workspace_id)

CREATE TABLE evaluations (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	result JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_evaluations_workspace_id ON evaluations (workspace_id)

CREATE TABLE memberships (
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	roles JSONB NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id, workspace_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id)
)

CREATE TABLE functions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	definition JSONB NOT NULL, 
	document_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	latest_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	validated_revision INTEGER, 
	validation JSONB, 
	disabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_functions_workspace_id ON functions (workspace_id)

CREATE TABLE agents (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	capability_ids JSONB NOT NULL, 
	allowed_origins JSONB NOT NULL, 
	suggested_questions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	current_release_id VARCHAR, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revoked_origins JSONB NOT NULL, 
	allowed_users JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_agents_workspace_id ON agents (workspace_id)

CREATE TABLE embed_tickets (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	agent_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	host_origin VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	instance_nonce VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	consumed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	source_token_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_token_id) REFERENCES auth_tokens (id)
)

CREATE TABLE function_versions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	function_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	definition JSONB NOT NULL, 
	compiled JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (function_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(function_id) REFERENCES functions (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_function_versions_workspace_id ON function_versions (workspace_id)

CREATE TABLE agent_releases (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	agent_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (agent_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(agent_id) REFERENCES agents (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_agent_releases_workspace_id ON agent_releases (workspace_id)

CREATE TABLE conversations (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	agent_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	release_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	token_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(agent_id) REFERENCES agents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(release_id) REFERENCES agent_releases (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(token_id) REFERENCES auth_tokens (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_workspace_id ON conversations (workspace_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_user_id ON conversations (user_id)

CREATE TABLE runs (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR, 
	question JSONB, 
	proposal JSONB, 
	answers JSONB NOT NULL, 
	confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	confirmation_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, client_message_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_runs_conversation_id ON runs (conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_runs_status ON runs (status)
CREATE INDEX ix_runs_user_id ON runs (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_runs_workspace_id ON runs (workspace_id)

CREATE TABLE calls (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	action_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	capability_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	definition JSONB NOT NULL, 
	arguments JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	result JSONB, 
	operation_id VARCHAR, 
	lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	dispatched_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (run_id, action_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_calls_run_id ON calls (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_calls_status ON calls (status)
CREATE INDEX ix_calls_workspace_id ON calls (workspace_id)

CREATE TABLE events (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_events_workspace_id ON events (workspace_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION intent_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
    BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Published versions are immutable'; END $$
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS immutable_version ON "function_versions"
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_version BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "function_versions" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION intent_immutable()
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS immutable_version ON "agent_releases"
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_version BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "agent_releases" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION intent_immutable()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION intent_embed_agent(requested_id text)
    RETURNS TABLE(workspace_id text, allowed_origins jsonb)
    LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
    SELECT a.workspace_id::text, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(o) FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.snapshot->'allowed_origins') o
    WHERE NOT a.revoked_origins @> jsonb_build_array(o)), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM agents a JOIN agent_releases r ON r.id = a.current_release_id
    WHERE a.id = requested_id $$
